chunks.text: Urban Place is an AI-governed home services and tutor marketplace. It uses FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Next.js and TailwindCSS. Features include AI identity verification for workers, AI qualification and skill evaluation for tutors, trust score from completion rate and ratings, policy-based provider listing, and 30% commission booking system.

AuraShop is an AI-powered personalized e-commerce assistant. It uses FastAPI, Next.js 14, and OpenAI GPT-4o-mini with session-based behavioral tracking. Features include real-time AI recommendation engine, AI chatbot with product comparison, QR code in-store pickup verification, AuraPoints wallet, and fallback AI system.

Code Dependency and Impact Analyzer is a Python static analysis system using AST parsing and NetworkX-style dependency graphs. It builds import graphs, computes blast radius and transitive impact, classifies change risk, and visualizes dependencies for safer deploys and refactors.

Initra is an offline-first home inventory PWA. It uses React, TypeScript, IndexedDB, Tesseract.js for OCR, barcode scanning, voice commands, QR code audit, and warranty management. Elderly-friendly design for cataloging possessions.

Autonomous Returns and Exchange Resolution System is a multi-agent AI workflow. It uses FastAPI, LangGraph, GPT-4o Vision, SentenceTransformers, and ChromaDB. Agents include VisionAgent, PolicyAgent, ResolutionAgent, and CommunicationAgent. AI analyzes return images, matches policy via RAG, and decides approve, reject, or escalate.

Expenze is a smart expense tracker with a WhatsApp AI chatbot. Users log expenses conversationally; the system categorizes spending, surfaces insights, and syncs with a responsive web UI for summaries and analytics.

BlinkGrid is a real-time multiplayer reaction game built with React, Node.js, Express, and Socket.io. Server-authoritative scoring, grids from 5x5 to 16x16, special tiles, AI bot players, and Web Audio feedback.
GoTrip is an AI-assisted trip booking platform with React UI: destination search, itineraries, personalized suggestions, and conversational travel guidance.

SmartLead AI is Salesforce lead automation: Web-to-Lead with Google reCAPTCHA, Apex and Flows for Hot/Warm/Cold scoring, assignment rules, dashboards, reports, and automated conversion with validation.

Messy to Neat is an AI meeting notes platform with React, TypeScript, and Supabase. Summaries, action items, flashcards, quizzes, mind maps, knowledge graphs, transcription, autosave, version history, and PDF export.

Tripza is a Next.js and TypeScript travel and vehicle marketplace on Firebase with Socket.io messaging: vehicles, trips, ride-sharing, booking requests, reviews, and provider tools—real-time coordination without in-app payments.

End-to-End Sales Cloud implementation: Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Products, Quotes, Orders, regional assignment, Agentforce automation, Experience Cloud where needed, secure Web-to-Lead with reCAPTCHA via Apex and LWC, dashboards, forecasting, and quote-to-order workflows.

Urban Place.architectureMermaid:
flowchart TB
  subgraph Client["Next.js Client"]
    UI[Tailwind UI]
    AUTH[JWT Session]
  end
  subgraph API["FastAPI Core"]
    ORM[SQLAlchemy]
    POL[Policy Engine]
    TRUST[Trust Score]
    BOOK[Booking + Commission]
  end
  subgraph AI["AI Services"]
    IDV[Identity Verification]
    TUT[Tutor Qualification]
  end
  UI --> API
  API --> ORM
  POL --> BOOK
  TRUST --> POL
  IDV --> POL
  TUT --> POL

dataFlow: Provider onboarding triggers document capture → AI extraction → policy gate.
Booking events append to ledger; trust score recomputed on completion/cancel.
Discovery reads trust + policy flags before ranking tutors.
deployment: Portable SQLite for demos; production path: Postgres + object storage for documents.
JWT-secured API tier; separate admin vs provider roles.
apis: REST-style FastAPI routes for auth, listings, bookings, payouts metadata.
Internal scoring endpoints consumed by Next.js server components / client.
decisions: Policy engine centralizes listing eligibility instead of scattering checks.
Trust score computed server-side to prevent client tampering.
scalability: Shard booking writes by region; cache hot discovery slices at edge.
Move verification to async workers when OCR/LLM latency grows.
challenges: Balancing tutor throughput vs strict qualification thresholds.
Keeping commission state machine idempotent across retries.

AuraShop.demoHint: Inspect AuraShop in Projects for session→recommendation flow detail.
AuraShop.architectureMermaid:
flowchart LR
  N[Next.js 14] --> F[FastAPI]
  F --> R[Recommendation Engine]
  F --> C[GPT-4o-mini Chat]
  F --> S[Session Store]
  R --> S
  C --> S
  F --> Q[QR Pickup Verify]

dataFlow: Click/view stream aggregates into session context vector.
Recommendations ranked with optional reasoning snippets.
Chat receives product focus + cart for grounded answers.
deployment: Session store colocated with API for low-latency reads.
Fallback AI path when upstream model is rate-limited.
apis: Recommendation POST with session id + catalog slice.
Chat POST with structured product context.
Pickup verification endpoint keyed by QR + order id.
decisions: Session-first personalization vs cold-start popularity blend.
Dual-path AI: primary + deterministic fallback for resilience.
scalability: Partition sessions by user shard; warm cache for trending SKUs.
Event stream to warehouse for offline re-ranking models.
challenges: Keeping chat citations aligned with live inventory.
QR flow sync with in-store POS edge cases.

Autonomous Returns Resolution System.demoHint: Multi-agent LangGraph workflow—see case study for agent contracts.
Autonomous Returns Resolution System.architectureMermaid:
flowchart TB
  IMG[Return Images] --> V[Vision Agent]
  V --> P[Policy Agent + RAG]
  P --> R[Resolution Agent]
  R --> C[Communication Agent]
  P --> CH[(ChromaDB)]
  P --> M[Embeddings]

dataFlow: Vision encodes damage/features → structured claim object.
Policy agent retrieves clauses via RAG from ChromaDB.
Resolution agent emits approve/reject/escalate with audit trail.
deployment: FastAPI orchestration layer around LangGraph state machine.
GPU/CPU hybrid: vision calls batched when possible.
apis: Internal tool APIs for human review queue.
decisions: Explicit agent boundaries for testability vs monolithic prompt.
RAG on policy corpuses instead of stuffing full policy text.
scalability: Horizontal workers per queue depth; isolate tenant policy indexes.
Cache embedding of stable policy sections.
challenges: Ambiguous photo evidence → calibrated escalation instead of false rejects.
Latency SLAs when chaining vision + retrieval + generation.
